paragraphs: Novo Solutions sells an operations management system called NovoGov, described on its site as a web and mobile cloud-based software solution for streamlining operations. The homepage lists the software as tracking and maintaining assets, receiving and processing work orders and inspections, providing customer support, and reporting on outcomes and progress. Other functions on that page include viewing assets on a map with maintenance history, and mobile or website access for citizens to submit requests and receive notifications.

The about page states that Novo Solutions has provided customer-driven web solutions since 1999, with technology and pricing scaled to a single department or across multiple departments. The same page names ShareNet as a cloud based information management system launched in 2013, with apps for work order management, asset management, and inventory management.

The case studies page describes public works and utilities departments adopting NovoGov for asset tracking, work order history, and citizen complaints. One case study describes a police department that adopted NovoGov to modernize asset and inventory management after a surprise audit revealed gaps in real-time inventory and historical records. Another describes a township road department that gained maps of assets, digital pre-trip inspections, and automated preventive maintenance.

quote.text: The NovoGov Operations Management system is an easy-to-use, highly flexible web and mobile cloud-based software solution designed to help organizations streamline their operations.
